edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-25. The complete 1930 official-gazette volume, containing among other acts the Bellarmine canonization-miracle decree (pp. 278-279) and Pius XI's decretal letter Lux illa of 29 June 1930 (pp. 593-604). No exact artifact is registered; consumers using the vatican.va OCR scan record their access route and date locally.
edition.title: Acta Apostolicae Sedis, volume 22

work.author: Holy See
work.description: The official gazette of the Holy See. Annual-volume editions and exact delivery artifacts remain container identities distinct from the constitutions, decrees, notifications, rescripts, and other acts printed within them.
work.title: Acta Apostolicae Sedis
